pages.title: Cannabis Product Disposal Decision Guide
pages.search_intent: separate ordinary cannabis product, recall evidence, battery electronics, glass or sharps, packaging, and chemical residue into safe locally verified disposal routes

pages.title: Cannabis Loyalty Rewards Value and Privacy Guide
pages.search_intent: compare a dispensary rewards program by usable value, break-even spend, expiry, exclusions, current local rule, data collection, consent, and exit path

monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The loyalty guide adds a neutral usable-value, effective-rate, and break-even calculator plus an auditable privacy and exit record. No merchant, program, product, price, coupon, ranking, product image, or affiliate link was added.

image_qa.note: The disposal reference, rewards calculator, and crawl-path work use semantic text, tables, controls, and existing brand interface assets. No editorial, product, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed.

search_console.decision: The September 21–October 18 report showed 1,093 impressions, three clicks, 0.3% CTR, and average position 19.2. The canonical sitemap remained pending with one error and the legacy endpoint showed two errors, so today's Data-led work strengthened crawl paths and added a unique-source inbound-link gate instead of publishing another query-cluster page. Stem Cell CBG at 19 impressions, one click, and position 6.0 was deliberately not reinforced again because it was materially expanded on October 15. Montana cannabis at two impressions, About at 11 impressions, Contact at nine impressions, and Blue Dream terms around positions 48–70 were ignored as too small, navigational, or outside the supported 4–20 opportunity range.

authority.action: Published a citation-worthy consumer disposal decision map with a stop gate, format matrix, battery/fire lane, seven-step handoff, and printable record grounded in current government sources. Reciprocal links strengthen the recall, complaint, vape-disposal, and ember-safety cluster. The crawl-path gate also repaired four hub-only guide routes and requires two unique HTML sources for every guide and gear detail page. No outreach was sent and no marginal opportunity was logged.
